abstract: The pathologic and radiographic findings of a homunculus originating in a mature ovarian teratoma are described and compared with those of 22 cases reported in the literature. To our knowledge, this is the first instance of an ovarian homunculus occurring simultaneously with an intrauterine pregnancy. In this case the upper extremities were better developed than the lower extremities. This was in contrast to the better developed lower extremities reported previously.
abstract_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫に由来するホムンクルスの病理学的および画像所見を記述し、文献上の22例と比較する。我々の知る限り、子宮内妊娠と同時に卵巣ホムンクルスが生じた例はこれが初めてである。本例では上肢が下肢よりも良好に発達しており、これは従来報告された下肢の発達が良好な例とは対照的であった。
